Copy vs differentiate. Copy them: Same offer, same price; Compete only on price. Find your angle: Serve a gap they miss; Explain why you differ
Use public information only. Your goal is to understand the market, not to imitate it. Look at what competitors show openly.

caption:
Competitor research: learn the pattern, find your own angle. 🔎

Looking at competitors is useful when you look for patterns, not when you copy their posts or prices. Start with three competitors your customers also consider, and note what is public: their offers, how they position themselves, how their pricing is structured, and what customers say in reviews.

Then ask: what do customers complain about, what does everyone say, what can we do better, and how will customers know? That is where your own angle starts.

The example in the carousel is hypothetical.
